MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 122
   C. 11
   D. 121

2. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 82
   D. 9

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 2
   C. 14
   D. 12

4. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 400

5. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 25
   C. 5
   D. 26

6. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 400

7. Solve for x: x + 5 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 12
   C. 11
   D. 16

8. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 49
   C. 2
   D. 48

9. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
   B. 3/4
   C. 1/2
   D. 1/4

10. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 170
   C. 13
   D. 26

11. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 14
   C. 7
   D. 49

12. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 0
   C. 65
   D. 64

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
